The picture in drop 3727 you probably refer to is not new, it appears in https://threadreaderapp.com/thread/1102404023217315841.html posted on March 4,2019. So there may be more of that zero deltas until now. And it says: Zero delta means in the same minute, not second. To get the same second is difficult, even if the same person pushes the "send" button simultaneously. Twitter/8chan/8kun needs some seconds to process a posting.

I counted 783 days since Q drop 1.

So with these values I get an expected value of 38 of these "zero deltas" (in the same Minute), by calculation:

(11464 * 3739) / (783 * 24 * 60)

(not 100% accurate, but > 99%)

and the same result by running a lot of simulations (as a check). This doesn't take in account that the drops and tweets mostly appear at certain parts of the day so that the probability is increased by that.

It includes all zero deltas, those where POTUS posts first and those where Q post first.

A match within the same second has an average probabilty of about 0.6 with the same context. So this would be very unlikely to happen 36 times. And it didn't happen.

So the random probability isn't as bad as one could think.

But still the really good Q proofs are those where Q post first and POTUS follows seconds afterwards and the best of these are the announced matches. In that case you just have to divide 11464 by the number of minutes what still gives a chance of about 1%. But when that works several times (n) without a fail, you get a probability of 1:(0.01^n) which is very unlikely to be by chance.

That was a question I asked myself before so I finally looked for an answer now. There's a more simplyfied solution: POTUS tweeted ca. every 100 Minutes (!!!) in average. So the chance that this happens in the range of one minute after Q is 1:100. For 3739 Q drops this means to expect about 37 times.

So the number of zero deltas is in the normal range. But the context (announced deltas, references in following POTUS posts etc.) is very convincing. Just 3 sequential announced zero deltas give 1:(100^3) = 1:1 million. And it's intended to give no 100% proof to protect Q and POTUS. For us there has been by far enough proof.
